ops.text: ROOT CAUSE of the v14 stale-build saga (supersedes both earlier entries): a SHARED CARGO TARGET RACE, not uv's wheel cache per se. All worktrees share ~/.cargo/shared-target; sibling lanes building different feature-sets of cc-transcript-core overwrite the shared rlib, so extension builds either link a stale core (canary returns pre-change output) or fail with unresolved imports. BOTH `uv sync --refresh-package` and `--reinstall-package` left stale/failed builds while the race was live. The reliable recipe, verified by two lanes: `CARGO_TARGET_DIR="$PWD/.cargo-target" maturin develop` (per-worktree isolated target) + a BEHAVIORAL canary (call a new function and check its output, not just hasattr). Every future parallel-lane setup in this repo should gate with exactly that pair.
